setup_notes: SQLite/Prisma has no native enum support — the status field is a String (default 'todo') with allowed values todo, in_progress, done documented in a comment; enforcement happens at the application layer
title non-empty constraint is not enforceable at the Prisma/SQLite schema level — must be validated at the application layer
Table maps to 'tasks'; due_date, created_at, updated_at columns use snake_case via @map, while Prisma client fields remain camelCase, per shared-decisions naming convention
Run 'npx prisma migrate dev' (or 'prisma db push' for SQLite dev) from backend/ after this change to apply the schema and regenerate the Prisma client
